response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT status, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER ()) OVER () AS avg_share FROM g) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh WHERE share > avg_share
